senses.gloss: f. (חבב, as גָּזִית fr. גזז, v. Fl. to Levy Talm. Dict. II, 2021) an arched, pouched vessel, (earthen) wine jug.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 3:1">B. Kam. III, 1</cite> (<cite ref="Bava Kamma 27a:18">27ᵃ</cite>, identical with <cite ref="K00098"><he>כַּד</he></cite>); a. fr.—
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 2:3">Kel. II, 3</cite> <he>ח׳ של שייטין</he> the swimmers’ bottle (used for practicing).—Pl. <he>חָבִיּוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 2:2">Ib. 2</cite> <he>ח׳ לודיות</he> Lyddean jugs, smaller than <he>לחמיות</he> Bethlehem bottles.
<cite ref="Niddah 6b:30">Nidd. 6ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="C00456"><he>גּוּף</he></cite> I h.; a. fr.
